              Product Description

              Our Secure Holder with Carabiner combines an innovative snap-and-lock system with aesthetically pleasing raised edges to keep your AirTag secure and scratch-free. Our AirTag cases are easily attached to your keychain, car remote, luggage bags, pet collar, and more with its convenient, sturdy, and simple to use carabiner clip. Choose from four stylish colors — black, red, pink, and green — that perfectly accessorize with your outfit while tracking your belongings 24/7. The Secure AirTag Holder doesn't just offer around-the-clock protection of your most important items. With its small frame and color selections, the AirTag Holder makes an excellent keychain accessory. Be safe and fashionable no matter where you go - grab an AirTag holder to match your personal style, or to pair with a custom engraving. Belkin Apple AirTag Holders are stylish, secure, and flexible. While Carabiners are perfect for bags and luggage, our durable airtag cases are also available in Wire Loop, Strap, and Key Ring form factors, so you can keep your belongings protected no matter what they are or where you store them. Complete your travel look with your own personal AirTag case, and never again worry about losing what matters most.
